intent: Stale-charter warning reads headings and Covers like the other charter checks
notes: The `stale-charter-refs` commit warning reported names that are not stale (#16). It took the text before a heading's first `(` as one function name, so `### Vendor cleanup in _run() / print_plan()` became "Vendor cleanup in _run", and it read `Covers` globs such as `dashboard/*.py` as literal file paths, so every function in a glob-covered file looked missing. On this repository it reported 19 names across 8 charters, all of them false.

It now reads headings with the same reader as the charter verifier and the new-function warning, and searches every tracked file the `Covers` line names (globs and folders included) plus each entry's `File:` line. On this repository it now reports nothing, and a function that was really removed is still reported.
`new-functions-undocumented` no longer fires on test files (#17); the shared significance policy from 2.37.0 already fixed it. A regression test now pins it.
